failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Chose a salient related answer instead of the answer type or referent specified by the clue, despite existing whole-clue and answer-slot checks.

rejected_edits.content: - For proper names, preserve the spelling and diacritics used in the clearest relevant context evidence; do not add, remove, or normalize diacritics when that changes the supported form.
rejected_edits.target: - Use the context-supported conventional form of a name or answer, and include additional name parts only when needed to distinguish otherwise-confusable entities.

rejected_edits.content: - For historically situated events, use the organization or brand name that applied at the time. Do not substitute a later rebrand, merged successor, or modern umbrella name unless the clue or context calls for it.
